articles.summary: Multiple individuals were indicted on January 2, 2025, in Texas on various criminal charges. Kody Lee Carter faces charges for possession of cocaine with intent to deliver. Shaquettia Sonya Carter was charged with assault on a peace officer. Francesca Marie Castro faces unauthorized use of a vehicle charges. Austin Chatman and Christopher Michael Coleman were separately charged with possession of controlled substances (methamphetamine and cocaine respectively). Coleman also faces additional charges of unlawful possession of a firearm by a felon and making terroristic threats. Tiffaney Margaret Crowder was indicted on multiple counts including two counts of assault against hospital personnel and harassment of a public servant.
